moments.title: Strictly Live Shows Hit The Floor
moments.blurb: The live shows for the 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing are now in full swing, bringing weekly ballroom drama to BBC One.

source.l: BBC One / Strictly Come Dancing Dates

angles.name: Strictly Buzz
angles.copy: Who's already shining and who's on thin ice? The Strictly live shows are well underway! Catch all the glitter and glamour.

angles.name: Weekend Recap
angles.copy: Still talking about the weekend's Strictly? We are! What was your favourite dance and who do you think will go all the way?

moments.title: Bake Off Back In The Tent
moments.blurb: The 17th series of The Great British Bake Off, featuring new judge Nigella Lawson, is airing weekly on Channel 4.

angles.name: New Judge Talk
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent! How are you feeling about the new judging panel and this year's batch of bakers? #GBBO

angles.name: Bake Off Night
angles.copy: It's Tuesday, which means it's Bake Off night! Get ready for more showstoppers, soggy bottoms, and brilliant bakes on Channel 4. #GreatBritishBakeOff

moments.title: England & Scotland In Nations League Action
moments.blurb: Both England and Scotland are playing their UEFA Nations League matches tonight. England face Czechia, while Scotland take on Switzerland.

angles.name: Match Night Build-Up
angles.copy: It's international football night! England vs Czechia and Scotland vs Switzerland in the Nations League. Who are you backing tonight? #NationsLeague

angles.name: Scotland Focus
angles.copy: Big night for Scotland! They face Switzerland in the UEFA Nations League tonight. C'mon Scotland! #SCOSWI

moments.title: Championship Football Returns
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship is set to return on Saturday, October 10th, following an extended international break.

angles.name: Championship Countdown
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The Championship is back next weekend after the international break. Who are you most excited to see back in action?

angles.name: Welsh Teams Back
angles.copy: Football fans, the wait is almost over! The Championship returns next Saturday – ready to see how Swansea and Cardiff kick off again?

moments.title: Sienna Spiro Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' holds the number one spot on the latest Official UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Sienna Spiro is still dominating the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Great Expectation'! What's your favourite track in the Top 40 this week?

angles.name: Chart Mix
angles.copy: From new entries like Adéla's 'Nicole Kidman' to classics like 'Mr Brightside' still charting, the UK Top 40 is a mix of old and new!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Halsey!
moments.blurb: Award-winning American pop superstar Halsey celebrates their 32nd birthday today.

angles.name: Halsey Turns 32
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 32nd Birthday to the incredible Halsey! What's your favourite track from them? #Halsey

angles.name: Halsey's Music
angles.copy: From 'Badlands' to 'If I Can't Have Love, I Want Power', Halsey has given us so many hits. Celebrating their 32nd today!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Les Claypool
moments.blurb: Primus frontman and bass guitar virtuoso Les Claypool turns 63 today.

angles.name: Primus Legend
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the one and only Les Claypool of Primus! A true bass legend. What's your favourite Primus track? #LesClaypool #Primus

angles.name: Bass Master
angles.copy: Celebrating the unique talent of Les Claypool on his 63rd birthday today. His groundbreaking bass work changed the game! #BassGuitar
